title: Logrolling affects the relative performance of majority and unanimity rule
title_zh: 互投赞成票影响多数规则与全体一致规则的相对绩效
title_primary: 互投赞成票影响多数规则与全体一致规则的相对绩效
title_secondary: Logrolling affects the relative performance of majority and unanimity rule
authors: Liza Charroin, Christoph Vanberg
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We consider a committee facing binary decisions on a number of proposals. If members vote sincerely and payoffs are symmetrically distributed, we show analytically that simple majority rule is the best q-majority rule in an aggregate or expected payoff sense. We argue that this (well known) pattern changes systematically if the committee faces multiple decisions and members engage in logrolling deals. In a simulation exercise, we find that unanimity rule outperforms majority rule when the number of proposals considered is large enough. We complement our analysis with a laboratory experiment designed to investigate whether human subjects engage in the logrolling deals assumed in our simulations. We find that deals associated with large negative externalities are less likely to arise than others, as are “complex” deals involving many voters or proposals. These results suggest that the impact of logrolling on the relative performance of the decision rules considered may be mitigated by cognitive constraints and other-regarding preferences.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个委员会在多项提案上做出二元决策的情形。若成员真诚投票且收益呈对称分布，我们通过分析证明，简单多数规则在总体或期望收益意义上是最优的q-多数规则。我们论证，若委员会面临多项决策且成员参与互投赞成票（logrolling）交易，这一（众所周知的）模式将系统性改变。在模拟实验中，我们发现，当考虑的提案数量足够多时，一致同意规则优于多数规则。我们通过一项实验室实验补充分析，旨在探究人类被试是否参与我们模拟中所假设的互投赞成票交易。我们发现，涉及巨大负外部性的交易比其他交易更不易出现，涉及众多选民或提案的“复杂”交易同样如此。这些结果表明，互投赞成票对所考虑决策规则相对表现的影响，可能因认知约束及他人导向偏好而有所减弱。

title: Coordinated Effects in the American Airlines‐US Airways Merger
title_zh: 美国航空与美国航空集团合并中的协调效应
title_primary: 美国航空与美国航空集团合并中的协调效应
title_secondary: Coordinated Effects in the American Airlines‐US Airways Merger
authors: Douglas C. Turner
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: I study the potential for collusion before and after the American Airlines‐US Airways merger. Results suggest the merger increased major airlines' incentives to coordinate their pricing decisions. US Airways was disinclined to collude prior to the merger due to its unique route structure which was highly dependent on connecting products. The merger, by combining the networks of US Airways and American Airlines, reduced US Airways' dependence on connecting products and enhanced its incentives to collude. Absent US Airways' unique premerger network structure, the merger would not have substantially increased major airlines' incentives to collude.
abstract_zh: 我研究了美国航空与全美航空合并前后共谋的可能性。结果表明，合并增强了主要航空公司协调定价决策的动机。合并前，全美航空因其独特的航线结构，高度依赖中转产品，而不倾向于共谋。合并通过整合全美航空与美国航空的网络，降低了全美航空对中转产品的依赖，并增强了其共谋动机。若无全美航空合并前独特的网络结构，该合并不会显著增强主要航空公司的共谋动机。

title: War and Science in Ukraine
title_zh: 乌克兰的战争与科学
title_primary: 乌克兰的战争与科学
authors: Ina Ganguli, Fabian Waldinger
official: 官方在线 2023-06-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We discuss the impacts of the Russian invasion on Ukrainian science. Using newly collected data, we show that the war has already had significant effects on science in Ukraine: research papers produced by Ukrainian scientists declined by about 10%, approximately 5% of the most prolific scientists are publishing with a foreign affiliation, 22% of top universities have faced destruction of physical capital, and international collaborations with Russian scientists have declined by more than 40%. Drawing upon the economics of science and innovation literature, we highlight three primary channels through which wars impact science: 1) the loss of human capital, 2) the destruction of physical capital, and 3) reductions in international scientific cooperation. The evidence from the literature on the long-run effects of losing human or physical capital indicates that shocks to physical capital can be remedied more easily than shocks to human capital. Our new data also suggests that human capital shocks are the main drivers of the reduction in Ukrainian research output that has occurred since the beginning of the war. Hence, reconstruction efforts should be focused on supporting scientists to continue in the research sector and to return to Ukraine after the war has ended.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了俄罗斯入侵对乌克兰科学的影响。利用新收集的数据，我们表明战争已对乌克兰科学产生了显著影响：乌克兰科学家产出的研究论文数量下降了约10%，约5%的高产科学家正以国外附属机构名义发表论文，22%的顶尖大学面临物理资本损毁，与俄罗斯科学家的国际合作减少了超过40%。借鉴科学与创新经济学文献，我们强调了战争影响科学的三个主要渠道：1）人力资本损失，2）物理资本破坏，以及3）国际科学合作减少。关于人力或物理资本损失的长期影响的文献证据表明，物理资本冲击比人力资本冲击更容易修复。我们的新数据也表明，自战争开始以来，人力资本冲击是乌克兰研究产出减少的主要驱动因素。因此，重建工作应侧重于支持科学家继续留在研究领域，并在战争结束后返回乌克兰。

title: Culture, Institutions & the Long Divergence
title_zh: 文化、制度与长期分流

abstract: this paper, we address these issues by modeling the joint evolution of institutions and culture. In doing so, we place the various hypotheses of economic divergence into one, unifying framework. We highlight the role that cultural transmission plays in reinforcing institutional evolution toward either theocratic or secular states. We extend the model to shed light on political decentralization and technological change in the two regions.
abstract_zh: 本文通过构建制度与文化共同演化的模型来探讨这些问题。我们将关于经济分化的各种假说纳入一个统一的框架之中。我们强调了文化传播在强化制度演化方向（无论是走向神权国家还是世俗国家）中所起的作用。我们进一步扩展模型，以揭示这两个地区政治分权与技术变革的深层机制。

title: Dissecting the Phillips curve: Evidence from cross-sectional heterogeneity and regime-dependent nonlinearity
title_zh: 剖析菲利普斯曲线：来自横截面异质性与体制依赖非线性的证据
title_primary: 剖析菲利普斯曲线：来自横截面异质性与体制依赖非线性的证据
title_secondary: Dissecting the Phillips curve: Evidence from cross-sectional heterogeneity and regime-dependent nonlinearity
authors: Wenxin Huang, Yiru Wang, Lingyun Zhou
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Accurately estimating the Phillips curve remains a significant methodological challenge. Recent panel data approaches reveal substantial cross-sectional heterogeneity, raising doubts about pooled estimates. This paper develops a novel group-based approach that systematically accounts for unobserved heterogeneity in the regional Phillips curve. We identify two distinct groups of U.S. states: one with a steep, significant Phillips curve, and another with a flat, insignificant relationship. Our results show that regional heterogeneity persists across regimes, with parameter nonlinearity emerging during recessions. Much of the flattening of the Phillips curve is region-specific, indicating the importance of both heterogeneity and nonlinearity in Phillips curve dynamics.
abstract_zh: 准确估计菲利普斯曲线仍是一项重大的方法论挑战。近期面板数据方法揭示了显著的横截面异质性，引发了对合并估计的质疑。本文开发了一种新颖的基于分组的方法，系统性地考虑了区域菲利普斯曲线中的未观测异质性。我们识别出两组不同的美国州：一组具有陡峭且显著的菲利普斯曲线，另一组则呈现平坦且不显著的关系。我们的结果显示，区域异质性在不同制度下持续存在，参数非线性在经济衰退期间显现。菲利普斯曲线的大部分平坦化现象具有区域特定性，表明异质性和非线性在菲利普斯曲线动态中的重要性。

title: Estimation and inference on average treatment effect in percentage points under heterogeneity
title_zh: 异质性下百分比点平均处理效应的估计与推断
title_primary: 异质性下百分比点平均处理效应的估计与推断
title_secondary: Estimation and inference on average treatment effect in percentage points under heterogeneity
authors: Ying Zeng
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In semi-logarithmic regressions, treatment coefficients are often interpreted as approximations of an average treatment effect (ATE) in percentage points. This paper highlights the overlooked bias of this approximation under treatment effect heterogeneity, arising from Jensen’s inequality. The issue is particularly relevant for difference-in-differences designs with log-transformed outcomes and staggered treatment adoption, where treatment effects may vary across groups and periods. This paper proposes new estimation and inference methods for an estimand that accounts for heterogeneity across observable subgroups and can improve upon conventional measures. The estimand provides a lower bound on the ATE in percentage points for the relevant target (sub)population, and coincides with it in the absence of within-group heterogeneity. I establish the methods’ large-sample properties and study their finite-sample performance through Monte Carlo experiments, which reveal substantial discrepancies between conventional and proposed measures when systematic heterogeneity is large. Two empirical applications further underscore the practical importance of these methods.
abstract_zh: 在半对数回归中，处理效应系数常被解释为平均处理效应（ATE）在百分点上的近似值。本文揭示了在处理效应异质性下，这一近似因詹森不等式而产生的被忽视的偏差。该问题对于采用对数转换结果变量及交错处理采纳的双重差分设计尤为相关，因为处理效应可能随群体和时期的不同而变化。本文提出了一种新的估计与推断方法，针对一个考虑可观测子群体异质性且能优于传统测度的估计目标。该估计目标为相关目标（子）总体在百分点上的平均处理效应提供了一个下界，并在不存在组内异质性时与之相等。我确立了这些方法的大样本性质，并通过蒙特卡洛实验研究了其有限样本表现，实验结果显示，当系统性异质性较大时，传统测度与所提测度之间存在显著差异。两个实证应用进一步强调了这些方法的实际重要性。

title: Family Institutions and the Global Fertility Transition
title_zh: 家庭制度与全球生育率转型
title_primary: 家庭制度与全球生育率转型
title_secondary: Family Institutions and the Global Fertility Transition
authors: Gobbi, Paula Eugenia, Hannusch, Anne, Rossi, Pauline
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Much of the observed cross-country variation in fertility aligns with the predictions of classic theories of the fertility transition: countries with higher levels of human capital, higher GDP per capita, or lower mortality rates tend to exhibit lower fertility. However, when examining changes within countries over the past 60 years, larger fertility declines are only weakly associated with greater improvements in human capital, per capita GDP, or survival rates. To understand why, we focus on the role of family institutions, particularly marriage and inheritance customs. We argue that, together with the diffusion of cultural norms, they help explain variations in the timing, speed and magnitude of the fertility decline. We propose a stylized model integrating economic, health, institutional and cultural factors to study how these factors interact to shape fertility transition paths. We find that family institutions can mediate the effect of economic development by constraining fertility responses.
abstract_zh: 观察到的跨国生育率差异，在很大程度上与经典生育转型理论的预测相符：人力资本水平较高、人均GDP较高或死亡率较低的国家，往往表现出较低的生育率。然而，在审视过去60年各国国内变化时，较大的生育率下降与人力资本、人均GDP或生存率的更大改善之间仅存在微弱关联。为理解这一现象，我们聚焦于家庭制度的作用，特别是婚姻和继承习俗。我们认为，这些制度与文化规范的传播相结合，有助于解释生育率下降在时间、速度和幅度上的差异。我们提出一个整合经济、健康、制度和文化的简化模型，以研究这些因素如何相互作用塑造生育转型路径。我们发现，家庭制度可能通过约束生育反应来调节经济发展的影响。

title: Human Capital Expenditure and Its Effectiveness on Multi-Program Coverage: A Policy Prioritization Investigation
title_zh: 人力资本支出对多项目覆盖率的有效性：一项政策优先级调查
title_primary: 人力资本支出对多项目覆盖率的有效性：一项政策优先级调查
title_secondary: Human Capital Expenditure and Its Effectiveness on Multi-Program Coverage: A Policy Prioritization Investigation
authors: Guerrero, Omar A., Guariso, Daniele, Castañeda, Gonzalo, Weber, Michael
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-07-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper uses artificial intelligence-enhanced agent computing to determine how to allocate budgetary resources within a large set of heterogeneous government programs targeting human capital. The approach considers essential features of the budget allocation process: multidimensionality, interdependencies between policy issues, and the political economy of public officials' collective action. The analysis uses highly disaggregated Mexican data covering the 2016-2022 period across 49 federal government human capital programs. It focuses on how expenditure affects program coverage, defined as the share of the population with a public problem and that has access to various government benefits to mitigate those problems, in the short run. The paper answers three research questions. First, how sensitive is program coverage to changes in public expenditure? Second, what are the structural bottlenecks behind poor coverage response? Third, what are the optimal budgetary allocations that could boost the performance of a multidimensional objective function?
abstract_zh: 本文运用人工智能增强型智能体计算方法，探讨如何在针对人力资本的大量异质性政府项目中分配预算资源。该方法考虑了预算分配过程的核心特征：多维性、政策议题间的相互依存性，以及公共官员集体行动的政治经济学因素。分析采用2016-2022年期间墨西哥49个联邦政府人力资本项目的高度细化数据，重点研究支出如何影响项目覆盖率——即存在公共问题且能获得各类政府福利以缓解问题的人口比例——的短期效应。本文回答三个研究问题：第一，项目覆盖率对公共支出变化的敏感度如何？第二，导致覆盖率响应不足的结构性瓶颈是什么？第三，能够提升多维目标函数绩效的最优预算分配方案是什么？

title: The Eurasian roundabout: Trade flows into Russia through the Caucasus and Central Asia
title_zh: 欧亚环岛：经由高加索和中亚流入俄罗斯的贸易流
title_primary: 欧亚环岛：经由高加索和中亚流入俄罗斯的贸易流
title_secondary: The Eurasian roundabout: Trade flows into Russia through the Caucasus and Central Asia
authors: Maxim Chupilkin, Beata Javorcik, Alexander Plekhanov
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper documents two strategies used to circumvent trade sanctions imposed on Russia following its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. The first involves transshipment through countries that do not participate in the sanctions regime. The second—simple yet largely undocumented—entails goods nominally shipped to neighbouring countries via Russia but failing to reach their declared final destination. Focusing on Armenia, Kazakhstan, and the Kyrgyz Republic, we show that during 2022–23 the two strategies offset roughly one third of the decline in European exports to Russia prompted by product-specific trade sanctions. We further find that sanctions led to only a modest increase in the unit values of products exported to Russia by both sanctioning and non-sanctioning economies.
abstract_zh: 本文记录了两种规避2022年俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰后所施加贸易制裁的策略。第一种涉及通过未参与制裁制度的国家进行转运。第二种——简单但鲜有记录——是指货物名义上经由俄罗斯运往邻国，却未能抵达其申报的最终目的地。聚焦于亚美尼亚、哈萨克斯坦和吉尔吉斯共和国，我们表明在2022至2023年间，这两种策略抵消了因产品特定贸易制裁而导致的欧洲对俄出口下降约三分之一。我们进一步发现，制裁仅使制裁国与非制裁经济体对俄出口产品的单位价值出现温和增长。

title: The heterogeneous effects of climate policy on households: Evidence from 88 countries
title_zh: 气候政策对家庭异质性影响的证据：来自88个国家的分析
title_primary: 气候政策对家庭异质性影响的证据：来自88个国家的分析
title_secondary: The heterogeneous effects of climate policy on households: Evidence from 88 countries
authors: Leonard Missbach, Jan Christoph Steckel
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: 官方在线 2026-06-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We analyze the distributional effects of climate policy by examining heterogeneity in households’ carbon intensity of consumption. We construct a novel dataset that includes information on the carbon intensity of 1.7 million individual households from 88 countries. First, we show that horizontal differences are generally larger than vertical differences. Then, we use supervised machine learning to analyze the non-linear contribution of household characteristics to the prediction of carbon intensity of consumption. Household income, proxied by total household expenditures, is usually an insufficient predictor for the additional costs of climate policy. Including household-level information beyond household income increases the accuracy of prediction. We identify ten clusters of countries that differ in the distribution of climate policy costs and their predictors. Our results highlight that, depending on the context, some compensation policies may be more effective in reducing overall heterogeneity than others.
abstract_zh: 我们通过考察家庭消费碳强度的异质性，分析了气候政策的分配效应。我们构建了一个新颖的数据集，包含来自88个国家170万个家庭消费碳强度的信息。首先，我们表明水平差异通常大于垂直差异。随后，我们运用监督式机器学习分析家庭特征对消费碳强度预测的非线性贡献。以家庭总支出作为收入代理指标，通常不足以预测气候政策的额外成本。在家庭收入之外纳入家庭层面的信息，能提高预测的准确性。我们识别出十个国家集群，它们在气候政策成本的分布及其预测因素上存在差异。我们的结果强调，根据具体情境，某些补偿政策在减少整体异质性方面可能比其他政策更为有效。

title: Electric vehicle charging at the workplace: Experimental evidence on incentives and environmental nudges
title_zh: 工作场所电动汽车充电：激励与环境助推的实验证据
title_primary: 工作场所电动汽车充电：激励与环境助推的实验证据
title_secondary: Electric vehicle charging at the workplace: Experimental evidence on incentives and environmental nudges
authors: Teevrat Garg, Ryan Hanna, Jeffrey Myers, Sebastian Tebbe, David G. Victor
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Aligning electric vehicle (EV) charging with periods of abundant clean energy is essential for decarbonizing transportation. In solar-dominated grids, this requires shifting charging to midday hours – when vehicles are typically parked at workplaces. Yet workplace charging networks operate under institutional constraints such as shared infrastructure, bundled parking and charging services, and limited willingness to require drivers to move vehicles, making time-of-day pricing and active management difficult to implement. In a natural field experiment (n = 629 drivers) across a large workplace charging network, we randomize time-invariant price discounts and environmental nudges that emphasize the environmental benefits of daytime charging. Price discounts modestly increase workplace charging but shift charging toward off-solar periods when charger occupancy is lower, while environmental nudges re-time charging toward solar hours without increasing total demand. A follow-up experiment shows that these timing responses are driven by perceived charger scarcity and congestion under price discounts. Finally, we quantify the abatement costs per ton of of these shifts.
abstract_zh: 将电动汽车（EV）充电与丰富的清洁能源时段对齐，对于交通脱碳至关重要。在以太阳能为主的电网中，这要求将充电转移至正午时段——此时车辆通常停放在工作场所。然而，工作场所充电网络受制于制度性约束，如共享基础设施、停车与充电服务捆绑，以及要求驾驶员移动车辆的意愿有限，这使得分时定价和主动管理难以实施。在一项覆盖大型工作场所充电网络的自然实地实验中（n = 629名驾驶员），我们随机分配了时间不变的折扣价格和强调日间充电环境效益的环境助推信息。价格折扣适度增加了工作场所充电量，但将充电转移至充电器占用率较低的太阳能低谷时段，而环境助推信息则将充电重新安排至太阳能高峰时段，且未增加总需求。后续实验表明，这些时间响应是由价格折扣下感知到的充电器稀缺性和拥堵所驱动的。最后，我们量化了这些转移每吨的减排成本。

title: Nonparametric Identification of Incomplete Information Discrete Games With Non‐Equilibrium Behaviors
title_zh: 非均衡行为下不完全信息离散博弈的非参数识别
title_primary: 非均衡行为下不完全信息离散博弈的非参数识别
title_secondary: Nonparametric Identification of Incomplete Information Discrete Games With Non‐Equilibrium Behaviors
authors: Erhao Xie
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies empirical discrete‐choice games with incomplete information under nonparametric specifications of both the payoff function and the distribution of private information. It relaxes the standard global equilibrium assumption —under which players follow equilibrium strategies for all realizations of the control variables—and introduces a weaker local equilibrium assumption that requires the equilibrium restriction only for some, but not all, realizations. Under this maintained assumption and standard exclusion restrictions, I derive the testable implications of the global equilibrium hypothesis and establish the nonparametric identification of all unknown functions in the model. This paper also discusses settings where the local equilibrium condition applies. The method is illustrated through a Monte Carlo experiment and an empirical application examining the competition between KFC and McDonald's in China. The estimation results strongly reject the global equilibrium assumption.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在不完全信息下的经验性离散选择博弈，其中支付函数和私人信息分布均采用非参数设定。它放宽了标准的全局均衡假设——该假设要求玩家对所有控制变量实现值都遵循均衡策略——并引入了一个较弱的局部均衡假设，仅要求在某些而非全部实现值上满足均衡约束。在此维持假设和标准排除性限制下，我推导出了全局均衡假设的可检验含义，并确立了模型中所有未知函数的非参数识别性。本文还讨论了局部均衡条件适用的情境。该方法通过蒙特卡洛实验和一项关于肯德基与麦当劳在中国竞争的实证应用进行了说明。估计结果强烈拒绝了全局均衡假设。

title: Taxation of Capital–Capital Levies and Commitment
title_zh: 资本课税——资本征收与承诺
title_primary: 资本课税——资本征收与承诺
title_secondary: Taxation of Capital–Capital Levies and Commitment
authors: Robert J Barro, V V Chari
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Chamley and Judd argued that optimal taxation dictates zero long-run taxes on capital income, but Straub and Werning found that these taxes may be positive in the steady state. These models feature a ‘period-zero problem’ because the Ramsey formulation omits past commitments but includes future ones. Chari, Nicolini, and Teles (2020) add commitments to the representative household’s wealth in utility units. Then a nonzero capital levy may apply in period 1, future tax rates on asset income equal zero, and tax rates on consumption are constant. Time-consistency fails if future policymakers are unconstrained but holds if wealth commitments in each period are strict enough to motivate each policymaker to choose zero capital levies. Then a timeless perspective applies where period 1 is not special, tax rates on asset income are always zero, and tax rates on consumption are constant. In the neoclassical growth model with utility depending on the log of consumption, the level of the wealth commitment is constant in the steady state. Extensions allow for uncertainty and heterogeneity and for a form of partial commitment.
abstract_zh: Chamley与Judd认为最优税收理论要求资本收入长期税率为零，但Straub与Werning发现稳态下此类税收可能为正。这些模型存在"第零期问题"，因为拉姆齐框架忽略了历史承诺却包含未来承诺。Chari、Nicolini与Teles（2020）将代表性家庭以效用单位衡量的财富承诺纳入模型。此时第一期可能征收非零资本税，后续各期资产收入税率均为零，消费税率保持恒定。若未来政策制定者不受约束则时间一致性失效，但若每期财富承诺严格到足以激励每位政策制定者选择零资本税，则时间一致性成立。此时适用无时间视角：第一期不再特殊，资产收入税率始终为零，消费税率保持恒定。在消费对数效用的新古典增长模型中，稳态财富承诺水平保持恒定。该框架可扩展至包含不确定性、异质性及部分承诺形式。

title: Crop Insurance Design and On‐Farm Risk Adaptation
title_zh: 农作物保险设计与农场风险适应
title_primary: 农作物保险设计与农场风险适应
title_secondary: Crop Insurance Design and On‐Farm Risk Adaptation
authors: Gerald Van Tassell, Alan P. Ker
official: 官方在线 2026-05-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The United States spends billions annually on crop insurance premium subsidies, yet the prevailing distance‐based guarantee design unintentionally rewards risk‐taking by linking subsidies to yield variability. We consider a simple redesign: define guarantees in terms of probability so that coverage reflects a consistent likelihood of indemnity. Using US data, this probability‐based approach would reallocate about $3.3 billion in annual subsidies from high‐risk to low‐risk production, reducing regional disparities by two‐thirds without changing total subsidies. Because most publicly subsidized crop insurance programs around the world share this structure, adopting probability‐based guarantees could help realign agricultural production toward more resilient and sustainable regions and practices.
abstract_zh: 美国每年在农作物保险保费补贴上投入数十亿美元，然而现行基于距离的保障设计因将补贴与产量波动挂钩，无意中激励了风险承担行为。我们提出一种简单的重新设计方案：以概率定义保障，使保险覆盖范围反映一致的赔付可能性。基于美国数据的测算表明，这种概率导向方法每年可将约33亿美元补贴从高风险生产重新分配至低风险生产，在不改变补贴总额的情况下将区域差异减少三分之二。由于全球大多数公共补贴农作物保险计划均采用类似结构，采纳概率型保障有助于引导农业生产向更具韧性和可持续性的区域及实践模式转型。

title: Regime-Specific Return Predictability in Quantiles
title_zh: 分位数下的制度特定收益可预测性
title_primary: 分位数下的制度特定收益可预测性
authors: Xinling Xie, Yundong Tu
official: 官方在线 2026-02-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This article captures the underlying regime switching mechanism in the prediction of stock returns via a predictive quantile regression with multiple thresholds. The predictability of each predictor is allowed to switch from one regime to another according to the value of a threshold variable and could vary across quantiles, and the predictors could possess heterogeneous degrees of persistence. Statistical learning techniques, including a sequential estimation procedure, an adaptive group Lasso refinement and a backward elimination algorithm, are adopted to estimate the unknown multiple thresholds. The adaptive Lasso is then applied to identify the important predictors in each regime to improve prediction accuracy at each quantile. Asymptotic properties of the proposed estimators are established, which are further corroborated with their nice finite sample performance revealed in simulations. The empirical analysis for the U.S. stock returns shows that the return predictability of several predictors changes with the economic states across the quantiles, demonstrating the regime-specific return predictability in quantiles.
abstract_zh: 本文通过带有多个阈值的预测分位数回归，捕捉了股票收益预测中的潜在机制转换效应。每个预测因子的预测能力可根据阈值变量的取值在不同机制间切换，并可能随分位数变化，同时预测因子可能具有异质性的持久程度。采用统计学习技术，包括序贯估计程序、自适应组套索精炼和向后消除算法，来估计未知的多重阈值。随后应用自适应套索识别各机制中的重要预测因子，以提高各分位数上的预测精度。所提估计量的渐近性质得以确立，并通过模拟研究进一步验证了其在有限样本中的优良表现。对美国股票收益的实证分析表明，若干预测因子的收益预测能力随经济状态跨分位数变化，展示了分位数上的机制特定收益可预测性。

title: Estimating the Interest Rate Trend in a Shadow Rate Term Structure Model
title_zh: 影子利率期限结构模型中的利率趋势估计
title_primary: 影子利率期限结构模型中的利率趋势估计
title_secondary: Estimating the Interest Rate Trend in a Shadow Rate Term Structure Model
authors: YANG HAN, JUN MA
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2025-10-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We introduce a no‐arbitrage dynamic term structure model integrated with a shadow rate and drifting trends to estimate the real interest rate trend in the United States, the United Kingdom, and Germany from 1972 to 2022. Our findings reveal declining interest rate trends across all three countries since the 1990s, underpinned by a significant co‐movement among them. We evaluate the long‐run correlations between the interest rate trends and various macro‐economic fundamentals to shed light on potential driving forces of the declining interest rate trend.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个结合影子利率与漂移趋势的无套利动态期限结构模型，用以估算1972年至2022年间美国、英国和德国的实际利率趋势。研究结果显示，自1990年代以来，这三个国家的利率趋势均呈下降态势，且彼此间存在显著的联动性。我们进一步评估了利率趋势与多种宏观经济基本面之间的长期相关性，以揭示利率下行趋势的潜在驱动因素。

title: Word2Prices: Embedding Central Bank Communications for Inflation Prediction
title_zh: Word2Prices：嵌入央行沟通文本以预测通胀
title_primary: Word2Prices：嵌入央行沟通文本以预测通胀
title_secondary: Word2Prices: Embedding Central Bank Communications for Inflation Prediction
authors: Douglas Araujo, Nikola Bokan, Fabio Comazzi, Michele Lenza
official: 官方在线 2024-12-18 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Word embeddings are vectors of real numbers associated with words, designed to capture semantic and syntactic similarity between the words in a corpus of text. We estimate the word embeddings of the European Central Bank's introductory statements at monetary policy press conferences by using a simple natural language processing model (Word2Vec), only based on the information and model parameters available as of each press conference. We show that a measure based on such embeddings contributes to improve core inflation forecasts multiple quarters ahead. Other common textual analysis techniques, such as dictionary-based metrics or sentiment metrics do not obtain the same results. The information contained in the embeddings remains valuable for out-of-sample forecasting even after controlling for the central bank inflation forecasts, which are an important input for the introductory statements.
abstract_zh: 词嵌入是与词语相关联的实数向量，旨在捕捉文本语料库中词语之间的语义和句法相似性。我们仅基于每次新闻发布会当时可用的信息和模型参数，通过使用简单的自然语言处理模型（Word2Vec），对欧洲央行货币政策新闻发布会开场陈述进行词嵌入估计。研究表明，基于此类词嵌入的指标有助于改善未来多个季度的核心通胀预测。其他常见的文本分析技术，如基于词典的指标或情绪指标，并未获得相同结果。即使在控制了央行通胀预测（这是开场陈述的重要输入信息）之后，词嵌入中包含的信息对于样本外预测仍具有重要价值。
